servicesBody: Everything stays organized by groups and reports — with attachments, notes, and share links when you need them.
servicePrescriptionBody: Store and update prescriptions, then share them with doctors when needed. Add a quick voice note for context.
serviceDocumentBody: Keep invoices, receipts, and important documents in one place — and share a link when you choose.
serviceOtherBody: Track objects with notes and attachments so you always know what you kept and where.
serviceReminderBody: A focused helper for families managing daily medicine routines.
serviceReminderPoint1: Track medicine stock and refill reminders
serviceReminderPoint2: Add supervisors (family members) to help track
reminderSpotlightTitle: Medicine reminders — built for daily life
reminderSpotlightBody: A calmer, family-friendly reminder flow that helps you stay consistent — with routines, refills, and shared supervision.
reminderFeature1Body: Set morning/noon/night routines with clear labels.
reminderFeature2Body: Track stock and get a reminder before it runs out.
reminderFeature3Body: Let a trusted family member help track and check.
reminderFeature4Body: Keep the prescription alongside the routine for clarity.
reminderPrivacyBody: Your routines and files stay private unless you choose to share.
howItWorksBody: A lightweight flow: store your docs, keep them organized, and share only when you need to.
howItWorksStep1Body: Upload images/PDFs, add a voice note, and keep context.
howItWorksStep2Body: Keep related items together so they’re easy to find.
howItWorksStep3Body: Generate a read-only link that can expire automatically.

getStartedModalBody: Choose a type to open the right page.
planBody: A simple free plan to start — with clear limits and transparent ads.
freePlanBody: Up to 100MB storage. Ads help keep the service running.
privacyBody: You control what you upload and what you share. No manual storage of credentials in the browser.
testimonialsBody: A few words from early users (demo).
testimonial1Quote: Finally, a calm place to keep my medical files.
testimonial2Quote: Sharing a prescription with my doctor is faster now.
testimonial3Quote: Simple UI, clear storage limits, and feels private by default.
faqA1: No. Storage is private-by-default and links are signed/short-lived.
faqQ2: Can I upload PDFs and images?
faqA2: Yes. Images and PDFs are supported in the app where uploads are available.
faqQ3: What happens when I reach my storage limit?
faqA3: Uploads are blocked once you exceed the hard cap. You can delete files to free space.

pricingFaqA1: Yes. Once Pro is available, you’ll be able to upgrade or downgrade anytime. Changes take effect at the next billing cycle.
pricingFaqA2: Pro is coming soon. We’re finishing billing integration and will launch Pro after testing. You can start with Free today.
pricingFaqQ3: What happens if I exceed my storage limit?
pricingFaqA3: You'll be notified when you're close. Once you hit the limit, uploads are paused. Delete files or upgrade to continue.
pricingFaqA4: We focus on sustainable monthly and annual plans. If you need something different, reach out to support@docspot.app.
